facts.fact: INEGE launched an international tender for updated satellite imagery, bids closing 31 March 2025, to build the mapping base for the V Population and Housing Census (V-CGPV), a first agricultural census and the second demographic and health survey.
facts.system: V Censo General de Poblacion y Viviendas (V-CGPV)

facts.fact: INEGE launched its satellite imagery tender under the National Statistical Development Strategy (ENDE 2022-2026), which the article presents as the government's current strategy.
